review.tagline: Agents, skills, hooks and rules bundle for Claude Code, Codex and other harnesses
review.summary: ECC installs a plan, test, implement, review, verify workflow into coding agents. It ships 71 agents, 311 skills, 97 legacy command shims, hooks, selectable rules, session memory and the AgentShield scanner for prompts, hooks, MCP config and permissions. Native plugin paths exist for Claude Code and Codex; Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Zed and others get capability-limited adapters.
review.audience: Developers running Claude Code or Codex who want a preset agent workflow
strengths: Large bundle: 71 agents, 311 skills, hooks and rules in one install
Guided setup wizard for Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code with dry-run mode
Includes AgentShield scanning of MCP config, permissions, hooks and secrets
MIT licensed; npm releases pinned per version tag
weaknesses: Feature parity varies; non-Claude harnesses are capability-limited adapters
Claude plugins cannot ship rules, so rule packs need a manual copy
Stacking install methods duplicates skills and hooks; README warns against it
needs: Needs Node.js 18+, Git, Claude Code 2.1+ (for plugin setup)
Models: Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code, Cursor, OpenCode
